commits.author: Seokhyeon Kim
commits.message:
fix: context cleanup for skipped Jupiter test classes (#33)

## Problem
When a Jupiter integration test class is skipped at class level (`@Disabled`, `@DisabledIf`, execution cancellation, etc.), the shared Spring context of its group is never auto-closed. Resources such as DB connection pools stay open while unrelated test groups run.

## Cause
`SmartDirtiesContextTestExecutionListener` marks a class complete in `afterTestClass`. A skipped class never receives this callback, so its group never becomes complete.

## Fix
- Add `SmartDirtiesSkippedClassListener`, a JUnit Platform `TestExecutionListener` (auto-registered via `META-INF/services`) that handles class-level `executionSkipped` events for Jupiter and reuses the existing completion/close logic.
- The context is closed only when no remaining class in the group needs it.
- If the whole group is skipped, the context is not loaded (only the configuration is resolved).

Scope: JUnit Jupiter only. TestNG and Kotest behavior is unchanged. The listener runs through the JUnit Platform Launcher, so it does not apply to direct engine execution such as `EngineTestKit`; the new tests use `LauncherFactory` for this reason.
